title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: BMW PGA Championship Update
items.text: Rory McIlroy birdied all four par-5s and moved near the lead early Thursday at BMW PGA, but three bogeys on the back nine left him chasing after Aaron Rai and Joakim Lagergren, who both shot 6-under 66s to lead the first round.

items.headline: Asian Tour Rejects LIV Golf
items.text: At a private meeting during the Open Championship, the Asian Tour decided to turn away from LIV Golf, striking a new alliance that reshapes the men's professional golf landscape.
